ExternalsPresetContext.summary.en: Context passed to externals preset resolvers.
ExternalsPresetContext.summary.text: 传递给 externals 预设解析器的上下文。

ExternalsPresetContext.environmentName.s.text: 正在解析的 Rsbuild environment（例如 `'lynx'`、`'web'`）。

ExternalsPresetContext.environmentName.r.en:
Presets use this to pick environment-specific artifacts — for example the
built-in `reactlynx` preset resolves the web-encoded `react.web.bundle`
for the `web` environment and `react.lynx.bundle` otherwise.
ExternalsPresetContext.environmentName.r.text:
预设通过它选择特定于 environment 的产物，例如
内置的 `reactlynx` 预设在 `web` environment 下解析 web 编码的 `react.web.bundle`，
在其他 environment 下解析 `react.lynx.bundle`。

ExternalsPresetContext.rootPath.summary.en: The current Rsbuild project root path.
ExternalsPresetContext.rootPath.summary.text: 当前 Rsbuild 项目的根路径。

ExternalsPresetDefinition.summary.en: Definition for a named externals preset.
ExternalsPresetDefinition.summary.text: 具名 externals 预设的定义。

ExternalsPresetDefinition.extends.summar.en: Other preset names to apply before the current preset.
ExternalsPresetDefinition.extends.summar.text: 在当前预设之前应用的其他预设名称。

ExternalsPresetDefinition.resolveExterna.en: Resolve external request mappings contributed by this preset.
ExternalsPresetDefinition.resolveExterna.text: 解析该预设提供的 external 请求映射。

ExternalsPresetDefinition.resolveManaged.en: Resolve managed bundle assets contributed by this preset.
ExternalsPresetDefinition.resolveManaged.text: 解析该预设提供的托管 bundle 资源。

ExternalsPresets.reactlynx.summary.en: Load the ReactLynx runtime bundle and wire its standard module globals.
ExternalsPresets.reactlynx.summary.text: 加载 ReactLynx 运行时 bundle，并配置其标准模块全局变量。

PluginExternalBundleOptions.externalBund.en:
Root directory that stores project-owned external bundles referenced by
`bundlePath`.

`pluginExternalBundle` uses this directory for both development serving
and build-time asset emission. Prefer setting this explicitly when
external bundles are built into a separate output folder, such as
`dist-external-bundle`.
PluginExternalBundleOptions.externalBund.text:
存放项目自有 external bundle 的根目录，这些 bundle 由
`bundlePath` 引用。

`pluginExternalBundle` 在开发环境提供服务和构建时产出资源时都会使用该目录。
当 external bundle 被构建到单独的输出目录（例如
`dist-external-bundle`）时，
建议显式设置该选项。

PluginExternalBundleOptions.externals.su.text: 额外需要加载的显式 externals。

PluginExternalBundleOptions.externalsPre.en:
Definitions for custom externals presets enabled by `externalsPresets`.

Use this to add business-specific presets such as `lynxUi`, or to extend a
built-in preset through `extends`.
PluginExternalBundleOptions.externalsPre.text:
由 `externalsPresets` 启用的自定义 externals 预设的定义。

可用于添加业务专属的预设（例如 `lynxUi`），或通过 `extends`
扩展内置预设。

PluginExternalBundleOptions.externalsPre.en:
Presets for external libraries.

Same as https://rspack.rs/config/externals#externalspresets but for Lynx.
PluginExternalBundleOptions.externalsPre.text:
外部库的预设。

与 https://rspack.rs/config/externals#externalspresets 相同，但适用于 Lynx。

PluginExternalBundleOptions.globalObject.en:
This option indicates what global object will be used to mount the library.

In Lynx, the library will be mounted to `lynx[Symbol.for("__LYNX_EXTERNAL_GLOBAL__")]` by default.

If you have enabled share js context and want to reuse the library by mounting to the global object, you can set this option to `'globalThis'`.
PluginExternalBundleOptions.globalObject.text:
该选项指定用于挂载库的全局对象。

在 Lynx 中，库默认挂载到 `lynx[Symbol.for("__LYNX_EXTERNAL_GLOBAL__")]` 上。

如果启用了 share js context，并希望通过挂载到全局对象来复用该库，可以将该选项设置为 `'globalThis'`。

PluginExternalBundleOptions.retries.summ.en: The number of additional attempts when fetching the external bundle times out (`response.code === -2`).
PluginExternalBundleOptions.retries.summ.text: 加载 external bundle 超时（`response.code === -2`）时的额外重试次数。

PluginExternalBundleOptions.timeout.summ.en: The timeout in milliseconds for loading the externals.
PluginExternalBundleOptions.timeout.summ.text: 加载 externals 的超时时间，单位为毫秒。

PluginExternalValue.summary.text: `pluginExternalBundle` 接受的 external bundle 引用。

PluginExternalValue.async.summary.en: Whether the source should be loaded asynchronously or not.

PluginExternalValue.background.summary.en: The options of the background layer.
PluginExternalValue.background.summary.text: 后台线程 layer 的选项。

PluginExternalValue.bundlePath.summary.en:
Bundle path resolved against the runtime public path.

Prefer this over `url` when the external bundle should be emitted or served
as part of the current project. `pluginExternalBundle` can use this
information to manage local bundle files, while the runtime keeps the final
URL aligned with the active `publicPath`.
PluginExternalValue.bundlePath.summary.text:
基于运行时 public path 解析的 bundle 路径。

当 external bundle 需要作为当前项目的一部分被产出或提供服务时，
优先使用该选项而非 `url`。`pluginExternalBundle` 可以利用这些
信息管理本地 bundle 文件，同时运行时会使最终
URL 与当前生效的 `publicPath` 保持一致。

PluginExternalValue.mainThread.summary.en: The options of the main-thread layer.
PluginExternalValue.mainThread.summary.text: 主线程 layer 的选项。

PluginExternalValue.retries.summary.en: The number of additional attempts when fetching the external bundle times out (`response.code === -2`).
PluginExternalValue.retries.summary.text: 加载 external bundle 超时（`response.code === -2`）时的额外重试次数。

PluginExternalValue.url.summary.en:
Bundle URL.

Use this only when the external bundle lives outside the current build
output and should not be emitted or served by `pluginExternalBundle`.

 Prefer `bundlePath`, which resolves through the runtime public
path and lets higher-level tooling manage asset emission.
PluginExternalValue.url.summary.text:
Bundle 的 URL。

仅当 external bundle 位于当前构建产物之外、
且不应由 `pluginExternalBundle` 产出或提供服务时才使用该选项。

 建议优先使用 `bundlePath`，它通过运行时 public
path 解析，并允许上层工具管理资源产出。

ReactLynxExternalsPresetOptions.summary.en: Options for the built-in `reactlynx` externals preset.
ReactLynxExternalsPresetOptions.summary.text: 内置 `reactlynx` externals 预设的选项。

ReactLynxExternalsPresetOptions.async.su.en:
Load the ReactLynx runtime bundle asynchronously, for the web target.

The web runtime (`@lynx-js/web-core`) can only fetch external bundles
asynchronously (`fetchBundle().then`), so ReactLynx must be mounted as a
promise that consuming modules await before reading a subpath (otherwise
`React.memo` etc. are read off a pending promise and are `undefined`).
Enabling this also resolves the web-encoded `@lynx-js/react-umd/{dev,prod}-web`
bundle and defaults `bundlePath` to `react.web.bundle`.
ReactLynxExternalsPresetOptions.async.su.text:
针对 web 目标，异步加载 ReactLynx 运行时 bundle。

web 运行时（`@lynx-js/web-core`）只能异步获取 external bundle
（`fetchBundle().then`），因此 ReactLynx 必须以 promise 的形式挂载，
使用它的模块需要先 await 该 promise 再读取子路径（否则
`React.memo` 等会从一个 pending 状态的 promise 上读取，结果为 `undefined`）。
启用后还会解析 web 编码的 `@lynx-js/react-umd/{dev,prod}-web`
bundle，并将 `bundlePath` 默认设为 `react.web.bundle`。

ReactLynxExternalsPresetOptions.bundlePa.en:
Emit the ReactLynx runtime bundle into the current build output and load it
through the generated runtime public path.

Prefer this over `url` for normal Rspeedy projects. In addition to letting
the runtime resolve the final URL from `publicPath`, the plugin will also
copy the corresponding `@lynx-js/react-umd` bundle into the emitted assets,
so application bundles can reference it without requiring an extra manual
copy step when publishing.
ReactLynxExternalsPresetOptions.bundlePa.text:
将 ReactLynx 运行时 bundle 产出到当前构建产物中，并通过
生成的运行时 public path 加载。

对于常规 Rspeedy 项目，优先使用该选项而非 `url`。除了让
运行时基于 `publicPath` 解析最终 URL 之外，插件还会将
对应的 `@lynx-js/react-umd` bundle 复制到产出的资源中，
因此应用 bundle 可以直接引用它，发布时无需额外的手动
复制步骤。

ReactLynxExternalsPresetOptions.reactUmd.en:
Package name that provides the ReactLynx runtime bundle.

Override this when wrapping the plugin for another distribution, such as
`@byted-lynx/react-umd`.
ReactLynxExternalsPresetOptions.reactUmd.text:
提供 ReactLynx 运行时 bundle 的包名。

为其他发行版封装该插件时（例如
`@byted-lynx/react-umd`），可覆盖该选项。

ReactLynxExternalsPresetOptions.url.summ.en:
Override the runtime bundle URL directly.

Use this only when the ReactLynx runtime is hosted outside the current
build output, for example on a CDN. Unlike `bundlePath`, this does not emit
any extra asset into the current compilation.

 Prefer `bundlePath`, which resolves through the runtime public
path and enables automatic asset emission.
ReactLynxExternalsPresetOptions.url.summ.text:
直接覆盖运行时 bundle 的 URL。

仅当 ReactLynx 运行时托管在当前
构建产物之外（例如 CDN 上）时才使用该选项。与 `bundlePath` 不同，该选项不会向当前编译
产出任何额外资源。

 建议优先使用 `bundlePath`，它通过运行时 public
path 解析，并支持自动产出资源。

ExternalsPresetDefinitions.summary.text: 可用的 externals 预设定义。

PluginExternalConfig.summary.en:
External bundle shorthand accepted by `pluginExternalBundle`.

When a string is provided, it is treated as `bundlePath` and the plugin will
infer:
- `libraryName`: the external request key
- `background.sectionPath`: the external request key
- `mainThread.sectionPath`: `${request}__main-thread`
PluginExternalConfig.summary.text:
`pluginExternalBundle` 接受的 external bundle 简写形式。

传入字符串时，它会被视为 `bundlePath`，插件会
推断：
- `libraryName`：external 请求的 key
- `background.sectionPath`：external 请求的 key
- `mainThread.sectionPath`：`${request}__main-thread`

builtInExternalsPresetDefinitions.summar.text: 内置的 externals 预设定义。

normalizeBundlePath.summary.en: Normalize a public bundle path by removing leading slashes.
normalizeBundlePath.summary.text: 规范化公共 bundle 路径，移除开头的斜杠。

pluginExternalBundle.summary.en:
Create a rsbuild plugin for loading external bundles.

This plugin wraps the externals-loading-webpack-plugin and automatically
retrieves layer names from the react-rsbuild-plugin via api.useExposed.
pluginExternalBundle.summary.text:
创建一个用于加载 external bundle 的 Rsbuild 插件。

该插件封装了 externals-loading-webpack-plugin，并通过 api.useExposed
自动从 react-rsbuild-plugin 获取 layer 名称。
